title: Typed documents
caption: Keep people, organizations and findings in structured records.
description: Documents are validated against the pinned StarIntel schema and stored in CouchDB.

title: Actors & queues
caption: Actors process messages. An actor is not an AI agent.
description: A Sento actor is a message-processing service with a specific job. Actors exchange documents through RabbitMQ; a service may use AI, but the actor model does not require it.

title: Evidence & relations
caption: Follow a finding back to the material that supports it.
description: Connect documents with typed relations, sources and supporting evidence.

title: Research publishing
caption: Review research before it reaches the public site.
description: Research requires operator approval and recorded evidence before publication. Published artifacts retain source and revision information.

title: Live public documents
caption: Read public records as they arrive.
description: Search a live feed of public documents, open each record, and keep anonymous network activity separate.

title: Quasar workspace
caption: Explore documents and their connections.
description: Quasar is a graph workspace for investigating documents, relations and sources.
